existingDispositions.rationale: Communal purity norms and individual moral conviction are different levels; realized exposure/internalization and target attitude must be specified.
Shared sacred-tradeoff prohibition is not individual conviction; selection and mutual reinforcement may explain association.
Actual mandate scope, awareness and perceived legitimacy differ; algorithm/human monitoring identity is not scope.
Threatened important freedom can elicit reactance, bounded by message/population and legitimacy; experimentally assigned message is not independently randomized perceived threat.
Negative cognition contributes to measured reactance; treating the composite as an independent cause of its counterargument component risks circularity.
Reactance is not universally positive for any specified behavior's group prevalence; opposition may reduce advocated behavior.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: High-control health messages increase perceived freedom threat.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA23 bounded scripts, populations and immediate four-item appraisal; no universal reactance/behavior effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Intentional binding is identical to perceived agency.
gapQuestions.rationale: Implicit/explicit measures dissociate; no semantic identity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Shorter feedback delay universally increases agency.
gapQuestions.rationale: Learned delay distribution can reverse the explicit-rating pattern.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Coercion reduces explicit agency or responsibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Implicit timing evidence does not independently establish exact explicit construct or legal responsibility.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Causal attribution locus increases on a scalar continuum.
gapQuestions.rationale: Nominal categories have no intrinsic order; a category shift needs a qualified specification.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Situational attribution locus equals stable locus of control.
gapQuestions.rationale: Attribution of one outcome differs from durable generalized expectation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Intentionality, responsibility, blame and punishment are interchangeable.
gapQuestions.rationale: Causal and mental-state inputs contribute differently.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Bad side effects are universally judged intentional.
gapQuestions.rationale: Cross-cultural convenience cohorts include reversed side-effect patterns.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Specified controllability information changes responsibility attribution.
gapQuestions.rationale: Stigma/affect/helping results vary; exact responsibility endpoint and task need extraction.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reactance independently causes its own negative-cognition indicator.
gapQuestions.rationale: Part-whole/shared-method dependence is not an independent causal contribution.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reactance increases every behavior's prevalence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Opposition, advocacy behavior and aggregation denominator differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Actual cultural moral norms equal an individual's moral conviction.
gapQuestions.rationale: Group rule/exposure and personal moralization are separate.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Moral obligation equals perceived injunctive norm.
gapQuestions.rationale: Personal felt duty differs from perceived others' approval.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Norm activation→duty→behavior is an identified causal pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Cross-sectional SEM cannot identify transmitted effects or temporal order.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Four-week benevolence package changes relative personal-value priority.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Brief value salience changes every enduring value dimension.
gapQuestions.rationale: Momentary cue and relative durable priority are distinct.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Moral-rightness questions increase felt moral obligation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Economic-game/donation behavior is not a direct duty measure.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Perspective-taking instruction increases general perspective capacity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Conversation increases perspective-taking capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Getting new information improves accuracy, not necessarily capacity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Sleep loss reduces perspective-taking capacity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Trust in science modifies REL-PSY-047 or REL-PSY-048.
gapQuestions.rationale: Measured science-trust grouping not exact PSY-113 source credibility; no exact-edge moderator evidence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Social-value threat independently produces reactance.
gapQuestions.rationale: Alternative predictive model, not independent causal mediator; exact canonical endpoint unresolved.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Moral conviction proves factual or moral correctness.
gapQuestions.rationale: Feeling fundamental right/wrong does not establish truth.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Algorithmic surveillance increases perceived freedom threat.
gapQuestions.rationale: Human-versus-algorithm monitoring and autonomy outcomes are not institutional scope or exact illegitimate-restriction appraisal.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Environmental crises change personal values.
gapQuestions.rationale: Life events, intervention and trauma designs heterogeneous; no uniform value/direction or immediate durable hierarchy.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Message→freedom threat→reactance→behavior has an identified transmitted effect.
gapQuestions.rationale: Threat check can follow cognition measurement; SEM and reachability do not establish causal mediation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Perspective-taking instruction or task accuracy is capacity itself.
gapQuestions.rationale: Operation, information availability, confidence, selection and general ability differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Learned feedback timing modifies explicit agency ratings.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA24 preserves reversed delay pattern; scoped measure/learning history needed.
